dataset.asset_split_strategy: Asset-level disjoint partitioning (168 train, 36 val, 36 test)
dataset.leakage_prevention: Strict asset-level separation ensures no temporal or asset-specific leakage between train and test sets.
dataset.limitations: Model trained on synthetic physics-informed degradation; field validation requires empirical water utility telemetry.

heuristic_threshold.description: Rule-based baseline flagging failure when pressure gradient > 0.14 bar or inlet pressure < 0.95 bar

technical_distinctions.anomaly_detection: Isolation Forest detects instantaneous out-of-distribution sensor anomalies.
technical_distinctions.leak_detection: Random Forest Classifier estimates the current degradation and vulnerability probability.
technical_distinctions.future_failure_prediction: Random Forest Regressor predicts remaining useful life (RUL in hours) before total breach.
technical_distinctions.explainability: TreeSHAP decomposes risk into segment-specific sensor and structural feature attributions.
